title: PPG-MS5 — Controller Dialect Coverage (6 families)
description: 6 controller families spanning 95% of US production: Fanuc 0i/16i/30i/31i, Hurco WinMax (UltiMotion G05.3 + 10K block lookahead + M140 Z-retract), Okuma OSP-P200/P300 (G131 SuperNURBS + G167 corner smoothing), Mitsubishi M700V/M800, Heidenhain TNC640/iTNC530 (Klartext + TCPM + CYCL DEF), Siemens 840D (CYCLE832 HSM + ShopMill). Each dialect is a thin layer over the master post engines; per-feature toggles (HSM, look-ahead, smoothing) honored. Owns PostDialectRouter creation.
rationale: Master posts produce abstract operations; controllers consume dialect-specific G-code. Mixing the two — what the legacy Fusion stack does — is exactly why posts grew to 300k LOC. Separating dialect emit from physics planning lets one master post serve every controller in the family with correct syntax.
leverage_existing: MachineFingerprint + FirmwareFeatures + PostBuildTaxonomy — controller introspection (cam dispatcher)
Existing dialect translators in cam_translate / gcode_transpile / dialect_translate actions
PostDialectRouter — already routes between OKUMA/MITSUBISHI; extend to all 6 families

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Same D2 die plate roughing op needs to run on Hurco V11 (WinMax) at JM Die and on a Heidenhain TNC640 at a sister shop.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms5: Two completely separate posts, drift independently. Hurco gets G05.3 smoothing; Heidenhain post forgets Klartext and emits ISO G-code that runs but ignores the controller's smoothing.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms5: Master post emits abstract op tree; WinMax dialect emits G05.3 P1 + M140 Z-retract; Heidenhain dialect emits CYCL DEF in Klartext + TCPM. Both correct, both maintained from one source.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Adding new dialects costs one engine, not a forked post.

units.title: Fanuc dialect engine (0i/16i/30i/31i)
units.scope: src/engines/FanucDialectEmitterEngine.ts — modal G/M tracking, G54-G59 WCS, Fanuc canned cycles G73/G81/G83/G84/G85, M-code spindle/coolant order discipline

units.title: Hurco WinMax dialect (UltiMotion G05.3 + 10K lookahead + M140)
units.scope: src/engines/HurcoWinMaxDialectEmitterEngine.ts — G05.3 P1 smoothing block, M140 Z-retract macro emission, conversational G65 macros

units.title: Okuma OSP dialect (G131 SuperNURBS + G167 corner smoothing)
units.scope: src/engines/OkumaOSPDialectEmitterEngine.ts — G131 NURBS surface, G167 corner smoothing, OSP variable namespace, VC variables

units.title: Heidenhain dialect (TNC640 / iTNC530 — Klartext + TCPM + CYCL DEF)
units.scope: src/engines/HeidenhainDialectEmitterEngine.ts — Klartext syntax, CYCL DEF cycles, TCPM tool-center-point management for 5-axis

units.title: Siemens 840D dialect (CYCLE82/CYCLE83/CYCLE832 HSM + ShopMill format)
units.scope: src/engines/Siemens840DDialectEmitterEngine.ts — CYCLE832 HSM mode toggling, R-parameters, ShopMill optional emit

units.title: HSM injection per dialect with material+feature lookup table
units.scope: src/engines/HSMInjectionStrategyEngine.ts — given (controller, material, feature) lookup table emits CYCLE832 (Siemens) / G05.3 P1 (Hurco) / G131+G167 (Okuma) / TCPM (Heidenhain) / High-Speed mode (Fanuc); tier-aware; HSM ON only when controller capability + feature geometry support it.

units.title: PostDialectRouter creation (BUILD owner)
units.scope: src/engines/PostDialectRouter.ts — central dialect resolver from controller fingerprint. MS4/U-PPGM34 then patches Roku-Roku alias. Layer boundary: MS5 BUILDS, MS4 PATCHES.

units.title: Extended dialect coverage: Mazak SmoothAi + DMG MORI Operate + Brother Speedio + Doosan Puma + rigid tapping cycles
units.scope: src/engines/MazakSmoothAiDialectEmitterEngine.ts + DMGMoriOperateDialectEmitterEngine.ts + BrotherSpeedioDialectEmitterEngine.ts + DoosanPumaDialectEmitterEngine.ts. Adds explicit rigid-tapping cycle support (G84/CYCLE84/CYCL DEF 207) per dialect. Closes PPG-REAL-MS0 orphan units U-PPR16/U-PPR37/U-PPR38.

completion_criteria: Every master post engine routes through a dialect emitter; no hard-coded G-code in master engines
All 6 dialect emitters pass byte-diff regression vs known-good shop programs (1 reference program per dialect)
PostDialectRouter selects the right dialect from controller fingerprint with zero false routes on the JM Die fleet
Per-feature toggle honored: HSM on/off changes G05.3/CYCLE832/G131 emission only, never the planned op
layer_boundary_note: PostDialectRouter is BUILT here (U-PPGM42c) and CONSUMED by MS4. Only one BUILD owner.
supersedes: F360-REV-MS8 (entire stub — PPG-MS5 owns dialect generation for 6 controller families)
F360-MS2/U-F360-15 (post-processor selection from PRISM CPS metadata — PostDialectRouter scope)
LATHE-MASTER/U-LTH132 (Swiss-type lathe dialect — folded into MS5 controller list)
legal_disclaimer: Controller dialect emitters implement public G-code/M-code conventions per controller vendor manuals. FTO opinion recommended before commercial deployment for HSM mode toggles (CYCLE832, G05.3, G131) which may have active vendor patents.
